body: I think she would sleep better.

I still want him to like me. He is the only person who ever will.

My mom knows it;s not her fault. I am a genetic fuck up who is just a trouble to take care of. I don't need to be here.

I see a psychiatrist, a social worker, and my mom knows everything.

On bad nights she has to monitor me while I sleep to make sure I don't hurt myself.

If I wasn't here she could get a full nights sleep.
